name: Bambu Lab Scraper
author: hageneez@gmail.com
description: Scrapes Bambu Lab filament prices and sends Discord notifications for stock changes, new items, and price changes.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y chromium chromium-driver wget curl git

cd /mnt/server

# Download scraper files
if [ ! -f scraper.py ]; then
    echo "Downloading scraper files..."
    curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hageneez/bambulab-scraper/main/scraper.py -o scraper.py
    curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hageneez/bambulab-scraper/main/requirements.txt -o requirements.txt
    curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hageneez/bambulab-scraper/main/config.example.json -o config.example.json
fi

# Install Python dependencies
pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Setup crawl4ai (skip browser download, use system chromium)
export PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1
pip install playwright
playwright install-deps chromium || true

# Create config if not exists
if [ ! -f config.json ]; then
    cp config.example.json config.json
    echo "Created config.json - add your Discord webhooks!"
fi

# Create data directory
mkdir -p data

echo "Installation complete!"
